Method & limitations

October 21, 2026 · Apple M5, 16 GB · Chrome 155.0.8059.85 · 1280×720. Each pair starts from the same saved scene. Same pinned code, daylight, camera, 1× speed, and simulation; only render pooling is toggled. Five-second warmup, 20-second measurement; before/after order alternates. One observation per condition on shared hardware, not a universal speedup guarantee. A later endpoint repeat was excluded after system load rose from about 4 to 222; its raw results are retained in the data file.

The first four points use single-tile generation. The 520/760/1,000-animal points use progressively expanded layouts with placement/access warnings. Their scene complexity also grows, so the curve is not an isolated animal-count cost model. Each scene additionally has 11 workers. Largest sampled collision count in this sweep: 0. Existing care/resource defects remain; improved FPS alone does not establish reliable settlement capacity.
